instruction: I have a party night poster that was accidentally moved to Trash. Please recover it and place it in the Pictures folder for proper organization.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Pictures/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: Task requires recovering the deleted poster from Trash and placing it in the Pictures folder. The evaluator checks if the file exists in /home/user/Pictures/ using command line. No custom functions needed as we use existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks file existence at the target location (/home/user/Pictures/poster_party_night.webp)
Shell command '[ -f ... ] && echo ...' reliably verifies file recovery and placement
Expected value 'File exists.\n' matches command output when task is completed correctly
Complete coverage: instruction requires file in Pictures folder, evaluator checks exactly that
No semantic or logical issues identified
